reference.question: In \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle DEF\), \(AB=DE\), \(AC=DF\), \(BC=2x+1\), and \(EF=13\). What must \(x\) equal for the triangles to be congruent by SSS?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Complete the SSS conditions

SSS requires \(BC=EF\), so \(2x+1=13\). Solving gives \(x=6\).
